brief:
Young Palestinian artists from Gaza and the occupied West Bank are displaying their works in simultaneous exhibitions, Al Jazeera English reported. The coordinated shows bring together creative output from both territories, creating a shared artistic space despite geographic and political separation.

Artists involved described their work as positioned alongside counterparts across the divide. The exhibitions connect creators from both regions who face restricted movement and limited resources in pursuing their practice.
dek: Young Palestinian artists in Gaza and the occupied West Bank bring their work together in simultaneous exhibitions.
title: Palestinian artists exhibit together across Gaza and West Bank divide
